question: How do I make tabs automatically synchronize across my documentation site when users switch between programming languages?
ground_truth: To make tabs automatically synchronize across your documentation site, add the `language` property to your Tab components. When a user selects a tab with a specific language, all other tabs across your documentation with the same language value will automatically switch to match. The language preference is stored in client-side local storage and persists across browser sessions.
